result.summary: Found 3 issues: overlapping text in the Tokumaru Ramen Bar card, a cut-off card at the right edge of 'Fastest near you', and inconsistent heart icon styling between cards.

issues.description: In the Tokumaru Ramen Bar listing, the delivery text shows overlapping/garbled text reading '25-3funddelivery' which appears to be two overlapping strings ('25-35 min' and '€0 delivery' or similar) rendered on top of each other.
issues.suggestion: Fix the layout/data binding so delivery time and delivery cost/label render as separate, non-overlapping text elements.

issues.description: The third card 'Trattoria Piccol...' in the 'Fastest near you' row is cut off at the edge of the screen, with its name truncated and only partially visible.
issues.suggestion: Adjust horizontal scroll padding or card width so the partial card is either fully hidden or shows a clear affordance (like a partial peek) indicating more content is scrollable.

issues.description: The heart/favorite icon has a white outline on the ramen card but a solid dark circle background on the pizza card below, creating inconsistent styling across similar components.
issues.suggestion: Standardize the favorite icon background style across all food cards for visual consistency.
